name: cutforge
description: Open-source video creation and editing plugin: your photos, clips and voice notes become story-led films, brand films, explainers and ads. 13 skills, 4 reviewer agents, a tested Remotion engine. Runs on Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Antigravity.

interface.shortDescription: Open-source video creation and editing plugin: your photos, clips and voice notes become story-led films, brand films, explainers and ads. 13 skills, 4 reviewer agents, a tested Remotion engine. Runs on Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Antigravity.
interface.longDescription: From raw footage to final cut. 13 skills + 4 reviewer agents + a tested engine (Remotion, ffmpeg and Python: 53 tools). CutForge runs the whole job: the brief, archive research (real capture dates, face clusters the client names, semantic search, the real sound inside phone clips), story design with arcs and a beat map, a look test and a data-driven storyboard, narration in any voice (cloned only with the owner's consent) verified line by line by speech-to-text, music-first sound design with a cue sheet that follows the timeline, AI art only where no camera was (never on real faces), chunked resumable renders where a fix re-renders one chapter, nine QC layers, delivery encodes, verified transfers and revision rounds. Family and milestone films, tributes, weddings, brand films, explainers, ads, and pharma and BFSI videos with India-first compliance. Portable across Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Antigravity via the Agent Skills open standard.
defaultPrompt: Make a 10-minute film from our family photos for a birthday.
Go through this photo library and find the best moments of 2024.
Write the story and storyboard for a 60-second brand film.
Here are my notes on the cut: fix the abrupt stops and the order at the start.
